task_prompt:
The supplied generate.py and candidate/ are a previously generated continuation for the Physics-IQ task in prompt.txt. Inspect and improve the program if needed, then generate the requested RGB video in this workspace. Keep the original task and first-frame constraint. Choose your own approach to checking and revision; no fixed review sequence is required.

No external review note is provided. Use your own judgement.
rules: Use only the supplied initial image, prompt, candidate/ and generate.py in this workspace. No network, other cases, future reference videos, evaluation masks/scores, memory, external AI models, learned renderers or physics engines. Local Python drawing, image operations and mathematical dynamics are allowed. Generate 20 RGB frames at 256x144, 4 fps (5 seconds); frame 00 must exactly match first_frame.png. Keep generate.py and use artifact_io.save to save the video. Choose whether and how to inspect or revise; save intermediate candidates.
